title: RekaCandidateProposals
description: Strict, unconfirmed Reka video observations that require human review before incident promotion.

offset_seconds.description: Seconds from the beginning of the clip where the visible event begins.

event_type.description: A bounded specific visible acute-event label.

description.description: One neutral sentence describing only visible evidence, without identity, intent, guilt, or speculation.

confidence.description: Confidence in the visual observation, not the probability that a crime occurred.
